Chapter 7156: Skykiller True Dragon

Chapter 7156: Skykiller True Dragon

“Skykiller True Dragon!” Apex and Hao Cai shouted in astonishment upon seeing the oppressive dragon.

“Your Majesty!” Those in Divine Firmament couldn’t help but prostrate on the ground upon seeing the ultimate divine beast.

He was not forgotten despite having passed away long ago. None could replace him, not Gluttonous or Chongming Immortal Lord. They were merely in charge of Skykiller Palace, nothing more.

Some believed that Skykiller would one day return to rule this world again.

Of course, this wasn’t the true dragon. The five divine beasts utilized totems to borrow the dead dragon’s power - a celestial immortal that had let go.

“Dao Origination!” Kun Peng unleashed his innate gift again. This time, it was at the apex level, surpassing karma and lasting longer than time.

The other eight worlds turned dark as well, draped by an ashen force.

“Apex power!” Primordial immortals in Heavenrealm became afraid.

The ultimate power attempted to reduce Li Qiye to nothingness.

“Can this be blocked?” Apex murmured since this could kill celestial immortals without apex power.

“Rumble!” Heavenrealm shook violently, on the verge of being flipped over or pushed up. If an existence could do this, they could also destroy Heavenrealm.

When everyone looked closer, they saw Li Qiye pushing up Dao Origination with his bare hands.

“Do you think this is apex power? How mistaken.” Li Qiye smiled and slowly pushed his palms together, crushing the draconic manifestation in the blink of an eye.

“Splash!” Surging waves returned to the sea of memories.

One must admit that the totemic fusion was incredible. They were powerful and most importantly, the sea was made from Skykiller True Dragon’s corpse. Thus, it contained his let-go cultivation.

Unfortunately, the attack only reached the boundary of apex power, not the real thing. After all, Skykiller had died long ago and his corpse was subjected to numerous refinements.

Only celestial immortals at this stage could fathom apex power. What the divine beasts did was far from enough when dealing with Li Qiye.

Thus, he continued to crush the totems.

“Not good!” They wanted to separate and escape from the totemic forms. Alas, it was too late.

“Sir, please show mercy!” The illusory voice spoke again.

A massive hand resembling a dragon claw reached for the totems. However, Li Qiye deflected it with a flick of the wrist before continuing the crushing.
